- No fallen-godhood hints, no past-power framing, no cosmic mystery language

- narrative/sessions/00_session0/PLAYER_PITCH_AND_PRINCIPLES.md (player-facing section)

The world uses Silk Road cultural anchors (Decision 14: 6 priority ancestries renamed with Silk Road references). The pitch and archetype descriptions currently use neutral/generic fantasy register — worth a conversation about how explicitly to signal the Central Asian / Silk Road heritage to players, and whether any of the current phrasing undersells or misrepresents the setting's cultural specificity.
